title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Acts 4: Peter and John before the council, the command not to speak in Jesus' name, and the believers sharing all things.

questions.text: Why were the priests, the captain of the temple and the Sadducees upset?
questions.explanation: They were upset because Peter and John taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

answers.text: Because they healed on a Sabbath
Because they taught the resurrection in Jesus
Because they entered the temple at evening
Because they spoke against the law of Moses

questions.text: What number did the men who believed come to be?
questions.explanation: Many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

answers.text: About five thousand
About three thousand
About one hundred twenty
About seventy-five

questions.text: Who is named as the high priest at this gathering?
questions.explanation: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

answers.text: Alexander
Caiaphas
Annas
Gamaliel

questions.text: What did the rulers ask Peter and John when they stood them in the middle?
questions.explanation: They inquired, "By what power, or in what name, have you done this?"

answers.text: Whether they had been with Jesus
Who had sent them to the temple
Why they had come at evening
By what power or in what name they had done this

questions.text: What did Peter say about salvation?
questions.explanation: Peter said there is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved.

answers.text: That it belongs to the rulers of the people
That there is no other name by which we must be saved
That it comes through the law of Moses
That it is for Israel only

questions.text: What did the rulers recognize about these unlearned men?
questions.explanation: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John they marveled, and recognized that they had been with Jesus.

answers.text: That they had been with Jesus
That they were trained scribes
That they were relatives of the high priest
That they came from Samaria

questions.text: What did the council command Peter and John?
questions.explanation: They called them and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

answers.text: To leave Jerusalem at once and not return
To bring the healed man before them
To pay a price for the miracle
Not to speak at all nor teach in Jesus' name

questions.text: How did Peter and John answer that command?
questions.explanation: They answered that they could not help telling the things which they had seen and heard.

answers.text: That they would obey the rulers
That they would teach in secret
That they cannot stop telling what they saw
That they would first ask the people

questions.text: What happened when the believers had prayed together?
questions.explanation: When they had prayed, the place where they were gathered was shaken, they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and spoke the word of God with boldness.

answers.text: The place where they were gathered was shaken
A cloud filled the house where they sat
An angel opened the doors for them
The rulers came and threatened them

questions.text: What does the chapter say the name Barnabas means?
questions.explanation: Joses, who was also called Barnabas by the apostles, is said to mean Son of Encouragement.

answers.text: Son of Consolation of Israel
Son of the prophets
Son of Encouragement
Servant of the apostles
